embodied_source: Hardware manufacturing, transport, end of life and data-centre construction, per kWh of facility electricity. 40 g/kWh, range 9 (GPU server, 4 years) to 47 (TPU v5e). Schneider et al. 2025, arXiv:2502.01671, Table 1: TPU embodied kgCO2e over 6 years / lifetime kWh = 35-47 g/kWh. Elsworth et al. 2025, arXiv:2508.15734, Table 2: Scope 1+3 0.010 g per 0.24 Wh prompt = 42 g/kWh. Mistral AI, Carbone 4 and ADEME 2025, Mistral Large 2 LCA: hardware 11% against 85.5% for use, so 37 g/kWh at 287 g/kWh.
